messages:
neha (Docs): quick sync: PR #5102 updates the "hello-deploy" quickstart to remove the inline key and unify Node/Python snippets. one thing: the deployment section still references an old container port (8080) but our starter image now listens on 8081. can someone confirm preferred wording and whether we should add a troubleshooting note?

leo (DevEx): good catch. yes, starter image switched to 8081 last month. we should: (1) update the deploy command in the tutorial, (2) add a 1-line troubleshooting tip "app returns 404 -> check container port" and (3) keep a CLI example that uses `--port 8081`.

omar (Eng): i can push a tiny change to the template repo so the sample Dockerfile exposes 8081 and the `run.sh` picks it up from $PORT with default 8081. will link the commit in the doc PR.

neha (Docs): also found a broken internal link to the "credential best practices" page in the auth section. will replace with the new /docs/security/credentials page. tagging QA for link check.

anya (QA): i'll run the preview checklist. can you add an example curl to validate the container once deployed? saves time.

neha (Docs): added this curl snippet to the PR: `curl -sS http://localhost:8081/health | jq .status` and a short note about common failures (port mismatch, missing env var REDWOOD_API_KEY).

preview-bot: preview build for PR #5102 completed (url: https://preview.redwood.dev/5102) — linkcheck: 1 broken -> fixed in branch, preview updated.

leo (DevEx): small SDK nit: the Node snippet uses `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })` but the official pattern is `new Redwood()` reading env automatically. prefer the latter for copy/paste. also add a 1-line migration pointer from SDK v3 -> v4 for folks hitting auth errors.

omar (Eng): i pushed the Dockerfile change to starter-templates@b7f4c and updated the `deploy.sh` to accept `--port`. linked in PR description.

neha (Docs): updated Node snippet to `const client = new Redwood()` and left a parenthetical about env var name `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. added migration link to the v3->v4 guide.

anya (QA): smoke-tested the preview: health endpoint responds, curl snippet works, auth note obvious. left two tiny copy nits: replace "press enter" with "press Enter" and fix one comma splice.

neha (Docs): fixed copy nits, squashed, and pushed. ready for review. tagging leo and omar.

leo (DevEx): reviewed, approved. small suggestion: add a single-line example for CI deploy (GH Actions) that sets REDWOOD_API_KEY as a secret. saves repeated questions.

neha (Docs): added a 4-line GH Actions snippet showing `env: REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}`. committed.

omar (Eng): approved the doc and starter template diffs.

neha (Docs): merged PR #5102. leaving a follow-up TODO in the repo to backfill a short migration blurb for users upgrading starter images. thanks everyone! :shipit:
